newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens to dollar, firms to pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens to dollar, firms to pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and firmed against the pound on Friday, dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 20.4665 to the dollar from 20.4295 on Thursday. The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 33.2345 to the pound from 33.2545 on Thursday.

Forex dealers said rupee weakening against the dollar was due to lack of intervention from the central bank on Thursday. They added that the slight strengthening of rupee against the pound reflected the international market trends.
"The market is short and hard currency demand from importers in increasing," one dealer said.
